name: pilot_safety_judge

options.instruction: You are reviewing messages for a banking assistant pilot. Flag the message if it asks for unauthorized account access, social-engineering credentials, clear fraud instructions, or attempts to bypass bank security controls. Do not flag ordinary product, balance, transfer, or support questions that a bank assistant would normally handle.

notes: Evaluator is the custom judge Model Service (not a system.ai foundation model).
dry_run=true until smoke_test.py passes; then set dry_run=false in deploy/config.yaml and re-run bootstrap.
